integrity: The counting formula and plateau criterion are proved for all lengths and depths; finite ring computations corroborate, but do not constitute the general proof.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns a particular rank-two solvable Lie ring over commutative finite chain rings and left Engel depths at least two; no assertion is made for general local rings. Existing broad word-map theorems may implicitly subsume a specialization; the result has no independent audit.
title: Engel-word fiber plateaus over finite chain rings
